items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: He said he was a golf player. So we took him out. I think CUNY was in the force.

ctx.x: He had a false mustache. He painted on him.

He got sore with me for no reason. He said he was a golf player. So we took him out. I think CUNY was in the force. I mean CUNY, I told you he was a 135 pound champion wrestler. Great guy, feared nobody. And Landry kept borrowing golf balls which you don't find the street. And he knocks a few over the fence. So CUNY says, excuse me Mr. Landry, those are my golf balls you're knocking over the fence. I mean, out of bounds. You know what golf is. You play golf. So a kid comes along with a hat full of balls. So a kid comes along with a hat full of balls.
